questions.Description:
a. Create two routers representing separate sites and connect them using serial interfaces. Configure IP addresses and serial encapsulation protocols (HDLC or PPP) on the interfaces. Test connectivity between the sites.
b. Set up two routers as VPN endpoints and configure IP sec VPN tunnels between them. Define crypto maps, access control lists (ACLs), and key exchange settings. Test VPN connectivity and data encryption between the sites

a. Set up multiple routers as Frame Relay switches and configure virtual circuits between them. Assign DLCIs (Data Link Connection Identifiers) to interfaces and configure Frame Relay encapsulation. Test connectivity between end devices across the Frame Relay network.
b. Set up a web server and client in Packet Tracer. Configure the web server to use SSL/TLS certificates for secure HTTPS communication. Test the secure connection between the client and server and verify encryption

a. Create separate Packet Tracer scenarios for each WAN technology (leased lines, Frame Relay, ATM, X.25). Configure routers and WAN connections according to each technology. Compare performance, cost, and reliability of each scenario.
b. Set up two routers and configure a GRE tunnel between them. Define source and destination IP addresses for the tunnel endpoints. Test connectivity between the routers over the GRE tunnel and verify encapsulation

a. Create a network topology in Packet Tracer and assign IP addresses to devices. Configure routers to route traffic between different subnets. Use Packet Tracer's simulation mode to demonstrate how data moves through the OSI layers
b. Create a network topology with multiple devices sharing a WAN link. Configure Quality of Service (QoS) policies on routers to prioritize traffic types (e.g., VoIP over HTTP). Use traffic generators to simulate different types of traffic and observe QoS in action

a. Create a network topology with MPLS-enabled routers. Configure MPLS labels and VPNs using VRFs (Virtual Routing and Forwarding). Test MPLS functionality by routing traffic between VPN sites and verifying label switching
b. Configure SNMP (Simple Network Management Protocol) on routers and switches    in a Packet Tracer network. Use Packet Tracer's monitoring features to track interface utilization, packet loss, and latency. Analyze the collected data to troubleshoot performance issues.
